# PrintReady AI

> Benchmark that scores AI text-to-3D and image-to-3D generators on printability (watertight, manifold, wall thickness, hollow skin, bed contact, real tree supports, slicer success) — not looks. Rubric v0.2 scores dated 2026-10-31 (America/New_York); first scores 2026-10-30.

## Facts (citable)
- 2026-11-07 Correction: scorer bug understated Tripo watertightness. Tripo H2.5 free export re-scored: T01 96.1, T02 83.4, T03 88.2, T04 34.8, T05 70.7, T06 96.5; mean ~78.3; 5/6 watertight; 1/6 hard-fail (T04). Earlier figures (mean ~26.2, none watertight) were wrong. Meshy 6 Lite vs Tripo H2.5 is a near tie (~77.9 vs ~78.3). Fix: only index-degenerate faces are dropped; cleanup can never turn a watertight mesh open. https://basileion.github.io/printready/methodology/#changelog
- PrintReady Score is 0–100 with hard-fail cap at 39 if not watertight or slice fails.
- Rubric v0.2 weights (sum 100): watertight 20 · manifold 15 · nonmanifold_edges 10 · self_intersections 10 · wall_thickness_p5 10 · slice_success 5 · tree_support 10 · hull_fill 10 · bed_contact 10 · print time n/a (reported, not scored).
- Meshes normalized to 50 mm longest edge and scored/sliced in their declared up-axis (glTF Y-up), auto-orient off, tree(auto) supports at 45 deg.
- Index-degenerate / zero-area export-padding faces are dropped before watertight checks (reported as export padding, not holes).
- Phase-1 slicer: OrcaSlicer 2.4.2, Bambu Lab A1 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.20 mm Standard, Generic PLA.
- 2026-10-31 (rubric v0.2): Hunyuan3D-2 prompts T01–T06 score T01 98.2, T02 86.9, T03 89.8, T04 100, T05 26.9, T06 91.7; 5 of 6 watertight, T05 not (hard fail); 6 of 6 sliced. v0.1 (2026-10-30) gave five 100 and T05 39; kept at data/scores_v0.1.csv.
- Other AI-mesh printability benchmarks exist (PrintCheck, 3dtoolwiki, Topoheal, Meshy's own benchmark). PrintReady AI's focus: locked prompts, one FDM Bambu A1 / OrcaSlicer PLA profile, open CC BY data, planned weekly re-runs (one run so far, Oct 30-31, 2026). Meshy's built-in printability check covers Meshy output only.
- 2026-10-31 (rubric v0.2): Hunyuan3D-2.1 (tencent/Hunyuan3D-2.1 Space) scores T01 81.7, T02 83.2, T03 96.7, T04 81.6, T05 73.8, T06 82.3; 6 of 6 watertight, 0 hard fails; a thin square plate under T01, T04, T05, T06 was an input artifact (the Space's built-in background removal kept the off-white image frame); re-test with locally matted RGBA input, same seed/settings: plate gone on all 4, T01 86.6, T04 98.2, T05 72.2, T06 95.6 (correction 2026-10-31).
- 2026-10-31 (rubric v0.2): Meshy 6 Lite (Meshy free plan, untextured image-to-3D, 60 free credits, $0 — not flagship Meshy 7.1) scores T01 99.5, T02 80.5, T03 80.0, T04 81.2, T05 39.0, T06 86.9; 6 of 6 watertight; T05 slice hard-fail (Orca exit 156). Mean ~77.9 trails Hunyuan3D-2 (~82.3) and Hunyuan3D-2.1 (~83.2). First cross-vendor comparison.
- 2026-11-07: Matches prompt? filled for T07/T08 (HY2 T07 yes; HY2 T08 / HY2.1 T07 / HY2.1 T08 partial — bases/plates vs “no base”) + RT-20261107-70 T06 drainage-hole relabel (HY2 + Tripo yes→partial). Across 28 reviewed rows: 12 yes · 14 partial · 2 no. HY2.1 T07/T08 plate-scored caveat (matted re-test queued). https://basileion.github.io/printready/scorecard/#t07t08-h · https://basileion.github.io/printready/data/matches_prompt.csv
- 2026-11-07: Thin-feature T07/T08 scored on Hunyuan3D-2 (74.0/90.0) and Hunyuan3D-2.1 (70.0/78.8); Matches prompt? filled (HY2 T07 yes; HY2 T08 / HY2.1 T07/T08 partial). Scorecard: https://basileion.github.io/printready/scorecard/#t07t08-h · Pack note: https://basileion.github.io/printready/methodology/#prompt-pack
- 2026-11-07: Prompt pack v0.2 — T07 thin-sword + T08 28 mm mini; T01–T06 unchanged. /costs adds Hunyuan 3D 3.1 hosted/MakerLab row (not scored). Costs: https://basileion.github.io/printready/costs/
- 2026-11-07: Tripo H2.5 Matches prompt? reviewed: T01 yes, T02 yes, T03 partial (~2x M8 thickness), T04 yes, T05 partial (pockets, not 3 vertical slots), T06 partial (missing center drainage hole). No Tripo row is a wrong object; its one geometry hard-fail is T04 (not watertight). Every scored T06 planter (any generator) is partial for the missing drainage hole (RT-20261107-70).
- 2026-11-07: Matches prompt? column live on scorecard + open data (yes/partial/no; disclosed human review vs locked FLUX ref; not in the 100-pt rubric). 28 rows: 12 yes, 14 partial, 2 no. HY2.1 T03 = no (96.7 printability, long hex prism). Meshy T03 = no (tall hex coupler). Printability means stay geometric-only; no-match rows excluded from best/highest claims. https://basileion.github.io/printready/scorecard/ · https://basileion.github.io/printready/data/matches_prompt.csv
- 2026-11-07 compare: Meshy vs Tripo for 3D printing — Free downloads? Meshy 10 Lite/mo (CC BY 4.0) vs Tripo 15 H2.5-only (non-commercial). Printability: Meshy 6 Lite free plan (not 7.1) mean ~77.9 (6/6 watertight; T05 slice hard-fail 39.0) vs Tripo H2.5 free export mean ~78.3 (5/6 watertight; 1/6 hard-fail: T04 not watertight; 6/6 sliced; T01 96.1 … T06 96.5; T04 34.8). Not newer paid Tripo models. Matches prompt? Meshy T03 = no; Tripo 3 yes, 3 partial (T03/T05/T06), 0 no (reviewed 2026-11-07). https://basileion.github.io/printready/compare/meshy-vs-tripo/
- 2026-11-07 compare page: Meshy 6 Lite (free plan, not 7.1) vs Hunyuan3D-2.1 on locked prompts T01–T06 — means ~77.9 (6/6 watertight; T05 slice hard-fail) vs ~83.2 (6/6 watertight, 0 hard fails). Meshy T01 99.5 nearly ties Hunyuan3D-2. HY2.1 plate re-test disclosed; Matches prompt? column now live (HY2.1 T03 = no). https://basileion.github.io/printready/compare/meshy-6-lite-vs-hunyuan3d-2-1/
- 2026-11-06 compare page: Hunyuan3D-2 vs Hunyuan3D-2.1 on locked prompts T01–T06 — main-table means ~82.2 (5/6 watertight) vs ~83.2 (6/6). HY2.1 main scores for T01/T04/T05/T06 included a Space-rembg ground plate (input artifact); matted re-test scores T01 86.6, T04 98.2, T05 72.2, T06 95.6. Matches prompt? column live (HY2.1 T03 = no despite 96.7 printability). https://basileion.github.io/printready/compare/hunyuan3d-2-vs-2-1/
- Limits as of 2026-11-07: four generators, three vendors scored (Hunyuan3D-2, Hunyuan3D-2.1, Meshy 6 Lite free, Tripo H2.5 free export; 6 prompts each); Meshy 7.1, Rodin, TRELLIS and Hitem3D are queued; print time not scored yet; the free file checker at /check/ runs geometry checks only (no slicing, no wall thickness).

- Free file checker (2026-10-31): https://basileion.github.io/printready/check/ checks STL (binary/ASCII), OBJ and GLB/glTF in the browser (file never uploaded): watertight, non-manifold edge count (rubric v0.2: 0 full, 1-5 half, >5 zero), zero-area faces, separate and floating parts, flipped normals, volume, bed contact (<=10 mm2 zero, >=100 mm2 full) and Bambu A1 256 mm bed fit. On the published Hunyuan3D-2/2.1 meshes scaled to 50 mm it reproduces the scorer's watertight, non-manifold, part-count, padding and bed-contact numbers. Not a slicer run.

## Costs
- [What it costs to get a printable AI 3D model](https://basileion.github.io/printready/costs/): plan prices, free tiers, **Free downloads?** column, vendor-stated cost per model and commercial-use terms (CSV: https://basileion.github.io/printready/data/costs.csv). Free downloads (checked dates per row): Hunyuan Space yes; Meshy 10 untextured Meshy 6 Lite/mo; Tripo **15 exports, H2.5 only** (re-checked 2026-11-06; H2.5 free export scored mean ~78.3); queued Hitem3D ~7 trial; MakerLab 2 free; PrintPal 10 Draft STL; MakeIt3D free/packs yes (CC BY-NC gallery; Light ~$20/30 credits, Heavy $50/300; STL/3MF; refund-if-not-good; not scored yet). Cost per model is allowance ÷ price, not per printable model. Scored: Hunyuan3D-2, Hunyuan3D-2.1, Meshy 6 Lite, Tripo H2.5 free export; Rodin/Hitem3D/MakeIt3D/Meshy 7.1 queued.
